summary: The first entry of a life or diary states the writer's situation: home, household, work and standing.
realLife: Pepys opened his diary with his situation: a garret in Axe Yard, his wife and servant, a clerk to Mr. Downing, with uncertain prospects.
sources: Diary of Samuel Pepys, January 1660, Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1660/January
inGame: The first chapter of the life story: `memoir-whenAge`, `household:livelihood`, `memoir-movedFrom`, with `place` from the household record.

turns.pulledBy: a life already under way, no opening record
turns.writesBack: the entry opens on the day and fills in later

turns.turn: The writer is new in town.
turns.pulledBy: a recent move on the record
